about_the_game:
This Pack includes:

  • Su-30MK2 AMV (Rank 8 USSR);

  • Premium account for 30 days;

  • 3000 Golden Eagles.

The Su-30MK2 AMV is an export variant of the legendary Russian multirole fighter for Venezuela, which joined the ranks of their Air Force in 2006. This modern aircraft combines the speed and maneuverability of classic Sukhoi aircraft with advanced avionics. It features a good radar with a target and threat identification, a “Rita” voice warning system, an IRST, a helmet-mounted display, an RWR with a target identification!

For air-to-air combat, the Su-30MK2 AMV is equipped with a 30 mm GSh-30-1 cannon with 150 rounds, and many advanced missiles such as the R-73E, R-27R1/ET1 and RVV-AE. It also comes with 96 large caliber countermeasures, and an option to turn off the AoA limiter to allow for extremely sharp maneuvers. For ground targets, the choice of weaponry is expansive — you can equip guided bombs such as the KAB-500Kr-M and KAB-1500Kr, and air-to-surface missiles like the Kh-29L, Kh-29TD, and the huge Kh-59ME. More classic weaponry is also available, including free-fall bombs from 250 kg to 1500 kg, along with many types of rockets, from the small but numerous S-8KO to the large and powerful S-25O.

Note!

  • Refund is not provided if you purchase 2 different packs which include the same vehicle or you already have the vehicle from this pack!

  • Available for Linux, Windows and Mac only. You can't activate this item for the PSN or Xbox Live account.
